Before I sign off on it, I need to hear from the S-3 and the motor pool chief on any schedule or readiness changes. Are all six training trucks available for the standard driver-certification block on Tuesday morning?

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a readiness change. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two will not be released until Friday at 0800, and they must remain on hold until their inspections are complete. This inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board, so the current draft board does not reflect it. That means we cannot run the standard driver-certification block with all six trucks on Tuesday morning.
